author: shuijikou
body:
what you mean by legit? it's always legit to move your buildings beyond their designated ares, that's how we have multiple refineries at home 

Now for moving you origin town to some where with dungeon location is fine, but this function is most benefits to people that needs to use portal during the day when they are not home, previously if you wanted to access portal to party members with tons of dungeons during working days not at home there isn't a "legit" way(there were not so legit way of turning off gps but let's not go that far), now people can  travel between work/home/party portal at ease

author: Kelyrrlith
body: Yes it is legit but also you will not be able to use your wayvessel anymore except you painfully move it from your new origin town to the place where you actually live.
